model.name: Hay et al. 2011 L5b pyramidal cell channel set in a single soma compartment (Soma_AllCML)
model.citation: Hay E, Hill S, Schuermann F, Markram H, Segev I (2011). Models of Neocortical Layer 5b Pyramidal Cells Capturing a Wide Range of Dendritic and Perisomatic Active Properties. PLoS Computational Biology 7(7):e1002107. doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002107
model.license: MIT (OSB LICENSE; exception: NEURON directory, cite-on-use condition; candidate files lie outside it)
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment (d 13.47 um, L 23.17 um). Ih 0.2, Im 0.0675, K_Pst 2.23, K_Tst 81.2, Nap_Et2 1.72, NaTa_t 300, SK_E2 0.08, SKv3_1 293, pas 0.0338 mS/cm2; Ca_HVA 0.992 and Ca_LVAst 3.43 mS/cm2 (Nernst); Hay Ca pool. Harness: -0.01 nA 100-200 ms, then +0.05 nA 300-400 ms. Shipped NEURON reference used by the jNeuroML OMV test (NEURON/test/.test.soma.mep): 7 spikes 306.3-397.0 ms, ISI 13.8 -> 15.8 ms (mild lengthening). Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: MIT; jNeuroML OMV test against a NEURON reference (GitHub check-runs at this commit: jNeuroML success). Adds Ih + T-type Ca (Ca_LVAst) + SK in a quiescent-looking cell: a possible route to the open sag/rebound gap (unverified). OSB-assembled soma test cell ("A single segment/compartment cell"), not a published single-compartment model. Shares all channel files with bbp2015_soma: keep both in the same split.
